title: Grant Award - U.S. Department of Education - School Diversification Project - Enrollment Department
official_text: Acceptance by the Board of Education of a Grant Award from the U.S. Department of Education, in the amount of $975,477.00, to support enrollment stabilization efforts via the School Diversification Project to reach all parts of the Oakland community, for the period of October 1, 2023 to September 30, 2025, pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof, via the Enrollment Department.
headline: Accepts a $975,477 U.S. Department of Education grant for the School Diversification Project
summary: The district is accepting a federal grant to support efforts to stabilize school enrollment through the School Diversification Project, which aims to reach all parts of the Oakland community. The Enrollment Department will manage the grant. It covers October 1, 2023 to September 30, 2025.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy and Data Sharing Agreement - Lozano Smith Law Firm - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy (MOUEP) and accompanying Data Sharing Agreement (DSA) by and between the District and Lozano Smith, Law Firm, Fresno, CA, for the latter under the MOUEP to provide specialized legal services regarding Fund 13, procurement, requests for proposals (RFPs), and contracts, on behalf of the Nutrition Services Department, for an amount not to exceed $10,000.00, and a Data Sharing Agreement (DSA), defining the terms and conditions of District's transmission of pupil data or sharing of data with Lozano Smith, and the protection by Lozano Smith, of such data, pursuant to the terms and conditions stated in the DSA, shared as a result of the MOUEP, each - MOUEP and DSA - for the term July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024.
headline: Hires Lozano Smith law firm for up to $10,000 of legal help on Nutrition Services contracts
summary: The district is approving an engagement agreement and a data-sharing agreement with the Lozano Smith law firm. The firm will give specialized legal advice to the Nutrition Services Department on procurement, requests for proposals and contracts, for no more than $10,000. The data-sharing agreement sets rules for how student data shared with the firm is protected. Both run from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted

title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – KM 106 Construction Inc. – Madison Park Primary Asphalt Removal and Replacement Project – Buildings & Grounds Department

title: Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction - King Construction Inspection, Inc. - Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction by and between the District and King Construction Inspection, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Inspector of Record Services, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project, in a not-to-exceed amount of $72,742.99, which includes a not-to-exceed $6,612.99 contingency for Additional Services, with the work scheduled to commence on December 14, 2023, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires King Construction Inspection for up to $72,743 of inspection work at Roosevelt Middle School

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Engineering Services Agreement - ENGEO - Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Engineering Services Agreement by and between the District and ENGEO, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional testing, lab analysis, field observation and project management services for remaining site construction, as described in the Proposal dated October 25, 2023, attached to this Amendment as Exhibit A, for the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project, in an additional total amount of $20,00.00, which includes a not-to-exceed contingency of $5,000.00, for Additional Services, increasing Agreement’s not-to-exceed amount from $110,015.00 to $130,015.00.00 and extending the term of the Agreement from March 25, 2021 through March 24, 2024 to December 31, 2024. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds testing and project management to ENGEO's Laurel Child Development Center contract, cap now $130,015
summary: This amendment adds testing, lab analysis, field observation and project management for the remaining site construction at the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project. It raises the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $110,015.00 to $130,015.00 (the text prints this as "$130,015.00.00") and extends the term to December 31, 2024. The official text prints the added amount as "$20,00.00", so that figure is unclear.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
